description: Read several tabs at once: the same state as exnos_verify for each readable tab matched. Exnos reads local pages (localhost, 127.0.0.1, *.localhost, local files) and any site the user has allowed by clicking the Exnos icon in Chrome; it cannot read or list other tabs, and you cannot allow a site.

includeStorage.description: Also return storage and cookies, credentials redacted. Default false.

maxText.description: Characters of page text (and selector text and HTML) per tab. Default 3000 / 2000, maximum 20000.

selector.description: Optional CSS selector applied to every matched tab. A tab without a match still returns its state, with selectorFound false.

tabs.description: Substrings matching readable tabs by URL or title. Each string matches one tab.

thirdParty.description: Also include requests to other sites. Default false.

name: exnos_fetch_tabs
